requirements.quote: Req ID: IAQ-INT-001 | Source / Rev: ICD-IAQ-03 | Requirement Text: The room CO2 measurement shall be represented internally as a Real-valued trace-substance mass fraction in kg/kg.
requirements.text: The room CO2 measurement shall be represented internally as a Real-valued trace-substance mass fraction in kg/kg.

requirements.quote: Req ID: IAQ-INT-002 | Source / Rev: ICD-IAQ-03 | Requirement Text: The controller shall provide a Real-valued ACH command to the airflow conversion gain.
requirements.text: The controller shall provide a Real-valued ACH command to the airflow conversion gain.

requirements.quote: Req ID: IAQ-INT-003 | Source / Rev: ICD-IAQ-03 | Requirement Text: The occupancy schedule shall provide an integer-valued people count to the CO2 source calculation.
requirements.text: The occupancy schedule shall provide an integer-valued people count to the CO2 source calculation.

requirements.quote: Req ID: IAQ-INT-004 | Source / Rev: ICD-IAQ-03 | Requirement Text: The fresh-air source shall receive both a mass-flow command and a trace-substance concentration parameter.
requirements.text: The fresh-air source shall receive both a mass-flow command and a trace-substance concentration parameter.

requirements.quote: Req ID: IAQ-SAF-001 | Source / Rev: DR-IAQ-05 | Requirement Text: If the room CO2 sensor signal is invalid for more than 60 s, the controller shall command 4.0 ACH and raise a sensor-fault indication.
requirements.text: If the room CO2 sensor signal is invalid for more than 60 s, the controller shall command 4.0 ACH and raise a sensor-fault indication.

requirements.quote: Req ID: IAQ-VER-001 | Source / Rev: CP-23 Rev C | Requirement Text: The 24-hour reference simulation shall log room CO2, outdoor CO2, occupant count, ACH command and physical supply mass flow at 60 s intervals.
requirements.text: The 24-hour reference simulation shall log room CO2, outdoor CO2, occupant count, ACH command and physical supply mass flow at 60 s intervals.

requirements.quote: Req ID: IAQ-VER-002 | Source / Rev: CP-23 Rev C | Requirement Text: During the approved 24-hour reference run, the maximum room CO2 concentration shall be no greater than 1000 ppm.
requirements.text: During the approved 24-hour reference run, the maximum room CO2 concentration shall be no greater than 1000 ppm.

requirements.quote: Req ID: IAQ-DAT-001 | Source / Rev: ICD-IAQ-03 | Requirement Text: The conversion between ppm and kg/kg for this benchmark shall use molecular weights 44.01 kg/kmol for CO2 and 28.97 kg/kmol for dry air.
requirements.text: The conversion between ppm and kg/kg for this benchmark shall use molecular weights 44.01 kg/kmol for CO2 and 28.97 kg/kmol for dry air.

requirements.quote: Req ID: IAQ-DAT-002 | Source / Rev: DR-IAQ-05 | Requirement Text: The value C={100} kg/kg in the peopleSource shall not be interpreted as the physical room concentration or a realistic gas mixture composition.
requirements.text: The value C={100} kg/kg in the peopleSource shall not be interpreted as the physical room concentration or a realistic gas mixture composition.
